Dave Matthews Band
May 18, 2022
Orion Amphitheater
Huntsville, Mississippi

Taper: Mark Terrell, linked up with Henry Hart & Ron Powell
Location: Front right pit rail, under right stack, 12 feet up
Source: Schoeps MK4s > Actives > Babynbox > Tascam DR-05X (24/48)
Lineage: WAV > Audacity 2.3.2 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

02. Madman's Eyes
03. #41

17. Walk Around the Moon
18. She
19. Pantala Naga Pampa
20. Rapunzel

22. Encore Break / Dave Speak: Kids
23. Sister
24. Warehouse

Dave Matthews Band:
Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Thank you to Henry Hart for the clamp space and for linking up to tape the show.
Thank you to Ron Powell for linking up to tape together.
